<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|CHA. IIII.|ACCORDING TO S. LVKE.|147}}</noinclude>{{verse|chapter=4|verse=31}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mat. 4, 13. 7, 28. Mr. 1, 21.''}}* And he vvent dovvne into Capharnaum a citie of Galilee: and there he taught them on the Sabboths. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=32}}† And they vvere astonied at his doctrine: because his talke vvas in povver. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=33}}† And in the synagogue there vvas a man hauing an vncleane Diuel, and he cried out vvith a loud voice, {{verse|chapter=4|verse=34}}† saying, Let be, vvhat to vs and thee {{sc|Iesvs}} of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy vs? I know thee vvho thou art, ''the {{sc|Sainct}} of God''. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=35}}† And {{sc|Iesvs}} rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, & goe out of him. And vvhen the Deuil had throvven him into the middes, he vvent out of him, and hurted him nothing. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=36}}† And there came feare vpon al, and they talked together one vvith an other, saying, VVhat vvord is this, that in povver and vertue he commaundeth the vncleane spirits, and they goe out? {{verse|chapter=4|verse=37}}† And the fame of him vvas published into euery place of the countrie.

{{verse|chapter=4|verse=38}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mat. 8, 14. Mr. 1, 30.''}}* And {{sc|Iesvs}} rising vp out of the synagogue, entred into Simons house. {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel vpon Thursday in the 3. vveeke of Lent. And vpon Saturday in Vvhitsonvveeke.}}And {{sup|‖}} Simons vviues mother vvas holden with a great feuer: and they besought him for her. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=39}}† And standing ouer her, he commaunded the feuer, and it left her. And incontinent rising, she ministred to them. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=40}}† And vvhen the sunne vvas dovvne, al that had diseased of sundrie maladies, brought them to him. But he imposing hands vpon euery one, cured them. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=41}}† And Deuils vvent out from many, crying and saying, That thou art the sonne of God. And rebuking them he suffred them not to speake, that they knevv he vvas Christ.

{{verse|chapter=4|verse=42}}† And vvhen it vvas day, going forth he vvent into a desert place: and the multitudes sought him, and came euen vnto him: and they held him that he should not depart from them. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=43}}† To vvhom he said, That to other cities also must I euangelize the kingdom of God: because therfore I vvas sent. {{verse|chapter=4|verse=44}}† And he vvas preaching in the synagogs of Galilee.⊣

{{c|{{larger|A N N O T A T I O N S}}}}
{{c|{{sc|Chap. IIII.}}}}

''13. Departed vntil a time.''] {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=The diuels tentations.}}No maruel if the diuel be often or alwaies busie vvith Chistian men, seeing after he was plainely ouercome by Christ, yet did he not giue him ouer altogether, but for a time.

''23. Done in Capharnaum.''] {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=Miracles at one place and not at an other.}}God maketh choise of persons and places where he worketh miracles or doeth benefits, though he might doe the same els where if it liked his wisedom. So doth he in doing miracles by Saints, not in al places, nor towards al persons, but as it pleaseth him. ''Aug. ep. 137''.<noinclude>{{rh||T ij|''30. Passing''}}</noinclude>
